title: Harry Seekings: Europe Requires ‘Rewiring’ to Meet Energy Demand
summary: Europe's energy markets are transforming. As companies across the region pursue future growth, the need for infrastructure that can meet the demands of energy expansion, energy transition and digitization is growing, too.

[Harry Seekings](https://www.apollo.com/aboutus/leadership-and-people/harry-seekings) on why Europe's[infrastructure](https://www.apollo.com/strategies/asset-management/real-assets/infrastructure) needs a fundamental rewiring, and why higher rates are reshaping how capital gets raised and deployed.


Timing right now in Europe is very interesting. This[Global Industrial Renaissance](https://www.apollo.com/insights-news/gir) we've talked about in the context of North America, applies equally in Europe, and in many respects, the[infrastructure](https://www.apollo.com/strategies/asset-management/real-assets/infrastructure) investment needs are[even greater in Europe](https://www.apollo.com/aboutus/our-locations/european-capital-solutions) .


It’s a developed market that needs significant rewiring. Apart from anything else, in order to facilitate Energy Demand,[Energy Transition](https://www.apollo.com/strategies/asset-management/real-assets/energy-transition) , and also[Digitization](https://www.apollo.com/insights-news/insights/2025/08/spotlight-financing-the-digital-infrastructure-surge) . There’s been a change in the macroeconomics where interest rates are now structurally higher. We’re seeing stickier inflation. And what that means is financing is more expensive. People are having to be more creative about how they raise capital and how they invest it. And bridging the gap between sometimes the perception of value on the behalf of equity owners and the reality of value in the current interest rate environment requires a level of creativity, I think Apollo is best placed to provide.
